data_fields.name: zone_cue_for_biome

data_fields.name: ambience_bed_gain_per_biome
data_fields.donor_constant: vale/beach wind 0.12; marsh-family 0.05 to 0.14; snow 0.13; rain 0.11; shore 0.18

best_idea: Give every music or ambience cue its own rise and fall time constant (fast rise into a fight, slow return), and pause any cue silent for four seconds so an inaudible track costs nothing.
decision_why: Keep the asymmetric time constants and the silent-pause keeper (cheap, client-only, no engine change), but use the fight seed instead of Math.random so a replay opens on the same track, and add a stinger or intensity step for the third attacker, since the donor has neither.
acceptance: Pull a mob in the open world or in the Pit: the zone music falls to near silence within about a second, one battle cue starts with the fight, and after the last kill it fades out over about 0.7 s while the zone theme returns; a client test that replays the same fight seed asserts the same battle cue index.
